plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.heading: What this node loaded, and what binds it
plugins.lede: Each plugin the engine registered, with the health it reports, joined with the streams it feeds and the sinks it writes. "Bound as" is what the configuration uses a plugin for; what a plugin could do is in its manifest, which the engine does not publish yet.

error.status: The engine's status endpoint is not answering, so loaded plugins and their health are unknown
error.streams: The stream catalog is not answering, so source bindings are not shown
error.sinks: The sink list is not answering, so sink bindings are not shown

empty.title: No plugins to show
empty.body: The engine reported no registered plugins and nothing is bound to one. A source or sink plugin is a jar on the node's plugin path, named in pravaha.streams or pravaha.sinks.

plugins.not_loaded_body: A binding names this plugin, but the engine has not registered a plugin by that name. Anything bound to it cannot run.
plugins.unbound: loaded, bound to nothing you can see

not_exposed.title: Not published by the engine
not_exposed.lede: Named here rather than guessed. Each is one answer the engine would have to add.
not_exposed.needs: The engine API that would answer it
